notes.title: What is next? New Update Sneak Peek!
notes.content:
Hi defenders,

Thank you so much to everybody that purchased the game. I hope you are enjoying it as much as I did making the game. Also thanks to those that spend their time providing feedback.

I'll explain the patch notes from this first week and after that I'll discuss what's comming.

[h2]Hot Fix Patches[/h2]
During last week, I've been patching some of the issues that have been reported. Among others:
[list]
[*] Support for all types of screen. Wide and narrow,any screen size. Before it was failing for some wide screens.
[*] Fix an issue where Mac and Linux executables were point to a wrong place. So now it should be playable for all devices.
[*] Fixed some missing characters for Chinese, Korean and Japanese languages.
[*] Some fonts were blurry, now they all are good.
[*] Fixed some German translation mistakes
[*] In some devices, Language and Screen Resolution dropdowns were not properly filled. Fixed.
[*] Fixed an exploit where you could sell all your towers before the end of the map to receive full gold for extra resources.
[/list]
All of these things should have been detected and fixed before launch, so I apologize for the inconvenience. Several hot patches were done during the week to fix them.

[h2]What is next?[/h2]
I'll be doing one more update with lot more content:
[list]
[*] 1 more hero
[*] 2 more towers + all their tree updates
[*] More skills, skill upgrades, relics.
[/list]
Also now I'm trying to fix an issue where sometimes pathfinding gets screwed and enemies stop moving. It's rare but it happens sometimes. 

Thanks again for reporting the bugs and feedback. You can continue doing so by the links:
[list]
[*] Bug Report: https://forms.gle/d97gYvdiuEz4pJM79
[*] Feedback Survey: https://forms.gle/EjZtQdTEVXmphCST8
[*] Discord: https://discord.gg/NxScVZYQjy
[/list]

Thanks and happy defend!
Alex & Anna

notes.title: Rogue Kingdoms Launches May 5th
notes.content:
Hi defenders,

Super excited to announce Rogue Kingdoms launch on [b]May 5th 2025[/b] - mark that in your calendars. 
The full game includes exciting new features and content beyond the demo:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749928/3d5d1ff70eb2c1a0f11b2f998629bcc1bcb8140c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]2 new maps and longer runs:[/b] In the demo, you defended 3 maps. Now, you’ll take on 2 more, including an epic final boss.
[*] [b]25 new enemies:[/b] On top of the 29 from the demo, face new foes with advanced mechanics that will challenge your strategy.
[*] [b]Infinite Mode:[/b] Built an overpowered loadout? Put it to the test in Endless Mode and see how long you can survive.
[*] [b]50 new relics:[/b] Powerful, synergistic upgrades join the 100 relics, 5 skills, 58 skill upgrades, and 20 traits already available in the demo.
[*] [b]Uncover the full story[/b] by beating the game 4 times.
[/list]

During the following weeks we'll do deep dive sneak peeks to expand on these features.

Stay tunned!

notes.title: Steam Deck Support
notes.content:
Hi Defenders,

Great news! Rogue Kingdoms now f[b]ully supports controllers and runs perfectly on Steam Deck.[/b]

No complicated setups—just install and play. We genuinely think playing with a gamepad or Steam Deck is the best way to enjoy Rogue Kingdoms.

Here's what's included:
[list]
[*] Full Input Compatibility: The Steam Deck’s controls work perfectly right out of the box.
[*] Optimized and Rebindable Controls: Controls feel smooth and responsive. Move the hero with one stick and your skills with the other—or swap them around. Customize controls to your preference!
[*] Docked Mode Ready: Want to play on a bigger screen? Easily connect a Bluetooth controller or keyboard to play docked.
[*] Clear, Easy-to-Read UI: Text and icons are designed specifically for the Steam Deck’s screen—no squinting needed.
[*] Long Battery Life: Game optimized to help your battery last longer.
[*] Smooth Performance: Enjoy stable, smooth gameplay at all times.
[*] Steam Cloud Saves: Switch effortlessly between PC and Steam Deck without losing progress.
[*] Native Compatibility: Runs perfectly on Steam Deck’s Linux system. Zero adjustments required.
[*] Quick Resume: Pause anytime and instantly resume gameplay without any issues or crashes.
[/list]

Let me know how it works for you!

And soon we're going to announce the release day. Excited about it!

notes.title: The last demo patch
notes.content:
[h2]New features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Choose from more starting builds: 6 per hero, including a more appropriate weapon per build.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749928/b058017623924a1577cb3ebd9de81d3cd6b7fd83.png[/img]

The game is quite close to release, soon we'll reveal the date. But if you want to take part of the playtest to see everything earlier, message me at:
alex@dracblaustudio.com

notes.title: Controller / Gamepad Support
notes.content:
Hi defenders!

We’re excited to announce that Rogue Kingdoms have from now on controller / gamepad support. Feels great to play with your gamepad exclusively, or even to navigate the UI with only keyboard.

[h2]Patch notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Controller support - fully play with your gamepad
[*] UI navigation with stick or keyboard exclusively.
[*] Full rebinding for both keyboard/mouse and gamepad.
[*] Pause during gameplay -> show wave info UI (enemies in wave + info & next waves)
[/list]

[h2]Balance changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sneaky Goblins -> When close to Castle they will undo invisibility.
[*] Sneaky Goblins & Necromancers -> When close to Castle they will not be able to cast Skills
[*] Taunt from boss only affects the shown area, and the attraction is smaller.
[/list]

[h2]What’s next?[/h2]
We still have a roadmap ahead before the full release. Among others:
[list]
[*] Maps 4 and 5 fully balanced, including the 25 new enemies that can appear in there.
[*] More content: relics, skills,…
[*] Endless Mode
[*] Further polish and quality of life
[*] And more…
[/list]

If you play with controller, let us know how it feels! :)

notes.title: Rogue Kingdoms in Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hi defenders!

We are excited to share that tomorrow Rogue Kingdoms will be participating in Steam Next Fest!
To celebrate it we are releasing a special limited edition demo for the next 2 weeks, with all relics unlocked!

Also, introducing some changes in the last patch:

[h2]Construction Mode:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We heard you. During stress moments, where the wave gets crazy, it takes a lot of time to click the tower to build or upgrade. 
[*] Now we have a Building Mode, just press Z or X and you’ll open a tower building UI. And with Z and X you can move to the next tower!
[*] This is going to be specially useful when playing with controller. Stay tunned!
[*] Also added New tutorial for building mode.
[/list]

[h2]Dialogue:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Created a storyline for the game, adding dialogues at the end of the maps and for the hero with the boss.
[*] The full version will have more storylines as you beat the game more times, and 2 more maps to expand the story.
[*] Now we have promoted our Intern Merchant to full employee, and he will explain some things when chatting with him.
[/list]

[h2]Visuals:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now Production Increase perks (wave reward) will appear in the top right corner so you know how much extra resources production you have.
[*] Added 2 extra tutorials for 1) Skill Upgrades, 2) Curses
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bug Fix: When calling start wave with key, next wave was automatically spawning
[*] Not really a bug, but increased the size of Tower Building icons, and made less blurry certain images.
[/list]

[h3]What’s next?[/h3]
[list]
[*] We still have a roadmap ahead before the full release. Among others:
[*] Story and dialogue (working on it)
[*] Controller support
[*] Maps 4 and 5 fully balanced, including the 25 new enemies that can appear in there.
[*] More content: relics, skills,…
[*] Endless Mode
[*] Further polish and quality of life
[*] And more…
[/list]

Super excited to see you all play during Steam Next Fest. Want to hear from you, what do you think about the demo?

notes.title: Tiny Actions, Huge Impact!
notes.content:
Hi defenders!

Last couple of weeks have been crazy. We've received lots of feedback from players and streamers, and it has been super useful!

We're not much more confident and ready for next week's Steam Next Fest.

[b]Balances Changes:[/b]
- Decreased Shaman's auto-healing to 10% of their damage.
- Buffed Magic Beam - now the effect is 33% faster - yes, it was annoyingly slow!
- Boss' Taunt now attracts more. You will always be able to escape independently of the weapon and movement speed you have, but the more movement speed the easier it will be.
- Swapped relics that grant certain effects when you get to10 or 20 stacks for the other one. Summoning when reaching 10 stacks was too OP!

[b]Improving information:[/b]
- Added tooltips to elements in the Pause menu for easier understanding.
- Added weapon stats in the Run Book - when hovering the weapon.
- Now in shop you can compare a weapon's stats to your weapons before purchasing it.
- Added a Run Book tutorial.

[b]Visual Changes:[/b]
- Reworked wave progress bar
- Increased size of currencies and curses in the battle UI,
- Added shadows to enemies.
- Shadows are fixed now, they don't change their direction with the character movements.
- Decreased some details in Barbarian. Now it has less abs! :)
- Added a new font to replace the secondary font.
- Changed text sizes so they are more consistent.
- Visual popups when spending gold or resources.
- Resources collection bar progress and resources collected popup.
- New animations for hero when they attack and run at the same time.
- Reworked all Cursors to better match the cartoony aesthetics of the game.
- When not starting the battle, the button will start shaking every 10s in case someone doesn't see it.
- When hero dies, now it shows their dead face and respawn counter in the Hero Bar (bottom left corner) also. And the respawning animation is back.
- Changed the "?" tip icon to follow the other buttons' consistency.

[b]Bugs:[/b]
- Fixed a rare bug where sometimes weapons were not visually changing in the UI
- Now boss again has their own music.
- Fixed a bug were the Tutorial was shown again when retrying a wav
- Fixed a visual bug when sometimes you saw a negative death respawn time for their trait.
- (Hopefully) Fixed a weird bug where the game paused when quickly entering the merchant.
- (Hopefully) FIxed a weird bug where some enemies get stuck in their path finding.
- Fixed Ogre Elite attack effect visual bug

[b]Settings:[/b]
- Default FPS = 60
- New setting to turn on/off showing range of hero or towers when hovering.
- New setting to turn on/off damage popups.
- New cursor size option

Others:
- Enhanced text and localization. We've remastered the whole text, corrected typos, explained things better and localized everything from scratch. 
- Decreased Mastery Experience required to level up at earlier levels.
- Changed Valkyries death sound
- Clearer tooltip explaining you can't upgrade to level 3 towers at first map.

[h3]What’s next?[/h3]

We still have a roadmap ahead before the full release. Among others:
- Story and dialogue (working on it)
- Controller support
- Maps 4 and 5 fully balanced, including the 25 new enemies that can appear in there.
- More content: relics, skills,…
- Endless Mode
- Further polish and quality of life
- And more…

notes.title: New Update - Quality of Life
notes.content:
Hi defenders!

We are approaching the release, expected for May 2025. We’ll also be participating in February’s Steam Next Fest. 

Because of that, his update has been focused on quality of life. Not much more content but building up on what’s on there and polishing it.

[h3]Mastery Level / Unlocks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Every time you finish a run (win or lose), you'll gery Mastery Experience. With enough experience you'll level up. Every level up (up to 38) will unlock a relic, meaning you'll be able to encounter them during the run.
[*] The goal of the unlocks is to hide some of the more complex mechanics for advanced players. If you want to unlock everything right away, you'll be able to if you select the "Unlock All" toggle in settings.
[/list]
[h3]Achievements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Created achievements: 13 for the demo, 38 for full release
[/list]
[h3]Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*] Game Over screen more clear and gamified.
[*] Maps 3, 4, 5 are now less bright, giving more importance to the character and towers.
[*] Also towers and heroes now have a shadow and a subtle brightness aura.
[*] Improved highlights when hovering on enemies or towers.
[*] When hovering on the hero, it will show the hero's area of attack.
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Wave Reward that gave resources over time now applies to the whole run instead of only the current map, and grants 5 resources / 6s.
[*] When you lose, you'll be able to repeat the same wave without starting over.
[*] Balanced probabilities of getting certain relics/skill upgrades.
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Steam Cloud Save enabled.
[*] Added credits page in main menu.
[/list]
[h1]What’s next?[/h1]
[list]
[*] We still have a roadmap ahead before the full release. Among others:
[*] Controller support
[*] Maps 4 and 5 fully balanced, including the 25 new enemies that can appear in there.
[*] More content: relics, skills,…
[*] Endless Mode
[*] Further polish and quality of life
[*] And more…
[/list]

notes.title: New Update - Quality of Life
notes.content:
Hi defenders!

Last update of the year, featuring many quality of life improvements:

[h3]Maps:
[/h3]- More diverse, more crazy maps.
- New Curse added which adds 1-2 more paths to the map.

[h3]Towers:
[/h3]- New level 2 tower upgrade for all towers: Strong Projectile - damage x2. This gives more build versatility, so you can build pure damage not involving Status Effects applied.

[h3]Enemies Friendly Fire:
[/h3]- Enemies can now damage themselves or other enemies. Also some enemies like Shaman can heal other enemies of the same species if the attack hits them.
- Enemies in map 1-3 that can damage other enemies are: Ogre, Ogre Elite, Shaman.
- Updated enemy descriptions to reflect this

[h3]Quality of Life:
[/h3]- Now Relics and Skill Upgrades draw have rerolls.
- New mode during Character Select to select a random combination of Hero - Starting Relics. 

[h3]Visuals:
[/h3]- Healing Tower only will show area when hovered
- When hover over Hero, the area of effect will show
- HP Bar is shown on top of the hero apart from the bottom HP bar.
- Improve highlighting of selected enemies or towers on hover.

[h3]Balance Changes:
[/h3]- Drops are now much more dependent on current build.
- Nerfed Archer's starting relic "Chaos Contagion". Before it added a random SE for each SE applied. Now it has a X% chance to do so.
- Nerfed Burst Mortar's Status Effect projectile. Before each projectile had 100 Status Effect Power. Now each will have 25.
- Boss has now more HP but there are less enemies to compensate for it.

notes.title: Huge Update: New Bosses, Difficulty Options and more!
notes.content:
[h3]Bosses:[/h3]
- 2 new bosses in map 3 replacing the previous ones: Dark Barbarian, Dark Archer. 
- You'll get as a boss enemy the dark hero you are not playing.  
- The boss will have a random weapon from the hero weapons pool
- The boss will have 2 skills: the 2 you don't pick when choosing skills in map 1 and map 2.

[h3]Difficulty and Map curses:[/h3]
- Removed previous Difficulty settings.
- Now you can choose 5 different difficulty modes. Depending on which one you choose, you'll get 0, 1, 2, 3 or 4 curses in each map.
- If difficulty is higher than "Normal", every map will have curses. In the first map you'll not be able to choose what curses it has, but in the rest it will be a deciding factor for what map to defend.
- Existing Curses can be (for now): 
  - Enemies have more HP
  - Enemies deal more damage
  - Enemies have higher movement speed
  - Waves spawn more Enemies
  - Hero gets less HP Regeneration
  - You get less building spots
  - You get less drawing aid
  - Reduced resources collected
  - Shop prices are higher (next shop)
  - Reroll prices are higher

[h3]Quality of Life / Miscellaneous[/h3]
- Now when choosing a map to defend there are 3 options.
- Enemies now are less cluttered, improving visuals and clarity
- Added many accessibility, graphics and quality of life settings
- Added speed time current times indicators.
- Added a mark to see where is the hero
- Changed wave rewards art
- Added a map and curses tutorial.

notes.title: New Hero & Summon
notes.content:
[h1]Status Effects Rework[/h1]
[list]
[*] Now SE can be stacked, and each stack will have the same intensity independently of the source. Stacks can go up to a maximum of 20.
[*] SE Power now only determines how many stacks to apply. Every 100 power will apply 1 stack, and the remaining is the chance for an extra stack. For example, 340 power will apply 3 stacks as a base, and 40% chance of being 4 stacks.
[*] Removed relics that allowed to stack SE from multiple sources
[*] Added many other relics related to SE. Some that provide extra effects/mechanics when reach 5-10-20 stacks of an element.
[/list]
[h1]Introducing new Hero - Ilyana[/h1]
[list]
[*] The new hero is an Archer, specialised in ranged attacks. She has half the HP of the barbarian, but can keep the distance to enemies.
[*] The hero has 6 new weapons she can use: bow, crossbow, longbow, shield bow, throwing axes, throwing knives, all with different stats and purposes.
[*] Also 3 new starting relics
[/list]
[h1]New Skill - Summon Valkyries:[/h1]
Created new skill: "Summon Valkyries". Very similar to Summon Barbarian, but now it's valkyries, yes. Valkyries have higher HP and armor but lower attack damage.

[h1]Summons Rework:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Now Barbarians throw axes from a distance instead of melee attacking. Their HP has been reduced.
[*] Now skill upgrades for "Summon Valkyries" and "Summon Barbarian" only apply to summons from the corresponding skill. And any relic upgrade will apply to ALL summons unless specified.
[*] Introduced many other summon mechanics after events (eg when reach 10 Poison Stacks, when killing with a crit,...)
[/list]

[h1]Others:[/h1]
[list]
[*] More than 100 relics or skill upgrades introduced or reworked.
[*] Heal towers for now are free, making them more viable. In the future they might also grant boosts.
[*] Improved movement feel when moving and targeting with mouse click.
[/list]
[h1]Next Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Rework Boss map 3
[*] Quality of Life 
[*] Add more options to personalise in Settings
[*] Reduce enemy cluttering and improve visuals
[*] New Hero Skills
[*] Lore, dialogues
[*] Quests, Achievements, Unlockable content
[*] And more.
[/list]

- Game has been optimised, weights less, loads faster and will run smoother.

notes.title: New Update: Exciting Demo and Trailer Unveiled!
notes.content:
This update is packed with numerous changes, new mechanics, and a lots of quality-of-life enhancements. Here’s what you can look forward to:

Key Features of the Update:

[h3]1. Comprehensive Tutorial:[/h3]
A new tutorial has been added to introduce the most important concepts, making it easier for new players to dive into the action.

[h3]2. Dynamic Skill Drafting:[/h3]
Skills will now differ in each game. You can draft the two skills most useful for your build as a reward for completing wave 1 in maps 1 and 2, adding a strategic layer to your gameplay.

[h3]3. Status Effects:[/h3]
Four status effects have been introduced: poison, burn, break, and freeze. These effects can be inflicted by all units, adding depth and strategy to combat. Learn more about them in the game.

[h3]4. Tower Upgrades:[/h3]
Towers now have four upgrade tiers:
1st Upgrade: Choose between enhancing range or attack speed.
2nd Upgrade: Modify projectiles.
3rd Upgrade: Select between a double shooter or a berserker shooter.
Projectiles from the second upgrade can now either cause status effects on enemies or heal allies.

[h3]5. Expansive Enemy Roster and Mechanics:[/h3]
Numerous new enemies and mechanics have been added, including challenging bosses that will test your strategic skills.

[h3]6. Relic Overhaul:[/h3]
The number of relics has increased from 16 to 101, each introducing game-changing mechanics that will keep your runs fresh and exciting.

[h3]7. Collection Feature:[/h3]
A new collection feature allows you to view all content, making it easier to track your progress and strategize for future runs.

[h3]8. Quality of Life Improvements:[/h3]
Numerous small quality-of-life changes have been implemented, enhancing the overall gameplay experience.

We invite you to play the updated demo, explore the new mechanics, and experience the improved quality of life changes firsthand. Your feedback is invaluable, so dive in and let us know what you think!

Stay tuned for more updates, and happy defending!

[b]Watch the new trailer now and embark on your journey in Rogue Realms![/b]

notes.title: Exciting Update in Rogue Kingdoms
notes.content:
Greetings, Defenders of the Kingdoms! We're thrilled to share a host of enhancements that not only improve the quality of life in Rogue Kingdoms but also amplify the 'juiciness' and overall feel of the game. Here’s what’s new in our latest update:

[h2]🎨 UI Enhancements
[/h2]
Interactive Feedback: Experience new auditory and visual feedback when interacting with buttons, panels, and icons. Feel the click and see the response every time you hover or select!

[h2]🕹 Gameplay Enhancements
[/h2]
Skill and Damage Enhancements: We’ve revamped the skill effects and damage animations to make combat even more satisfying.

Tower Construction and Purchases: Enjoy enhanced sound effects and visuals that make building your defenses a visceral experience.

[h2]🌟 New Difficulty Levels
[/h2]
After your initial triumph, unlock new difficulty settings. Tailor your challenge: more foes, smarter enemies, or maybe less time?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749928/09a530aaf3c1d3ccd5df1bd1c55c175ec2eb897a.png[/img]

[h2]⚙ Quality of Life Improvements
[/h2]
Convenience Settings: Navigate to Settings to enable quick casting, upgrade towers even when hero is dead, and more.

Streamlined Interactions: Escape key now smartly cancels spells or exits menus. Plus, added confirmations prevent accidental purchases or salvages.

Enhanced Pathfinding: Heroes and enemies now navigate the maps more smoothly, making for more strategic and less frustrating encounters.

[h2]🔧 Balance Adjustments
[/h2]
Progressive Difficulty: We’ve smoothed out the progression curve—easier early levels and more challenging maps await as you delve deeper.

[h2]📊 Post-Game Insights
[/h2]
Damage Metrics: Post-game, analyze your strategies with detailed damage metrics by type—perfect your build for the next run!

[h2]🎁 And More...
[/h2]
Discover additional tweaks and surprises that await you in-game—each designed to enrich your tactical and immersive experience in the realm!

We are committed to continuously refining Rogue Kingdoms to create the most engaging and enjoyable experience for all our players. Dive back into the game and test out these enhancements. As always, we value your feedback and look forward to your tales of conquest and glory!

Happy defending!

— The Rogue Kingdoms Team

notes.title: 🏰 Rogue Realms: Exciting New Update & Future Roadmap! 🛡️
notes.content:

[list]
[*] [b]Improved Visuals:[/b] Immerse yourself in a more vivid world with enhanced UI, detailed maps, revamped castle designs, and more dynamic cards and traits. The visual splendor of Rogue Realms has never been better!

[*] [b]Localization Bonanza:[/b] We're now almost fully localized in a wide array of languages including English, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Japanese, Korean, German, Polish, French, Russian, Indonesian, Portuguese (Brazil), Thai, Catalan, and Italian. Stay vigilant, defenders!

- The Rogue Realms Team

Hey Rogue Realms warriors!

We're thrilled to announce a fantastic update to the Rogue Realms demo, bringing in some cool new features and improvements that we can't wait for you to try out. As always, our journey is shaped by your feedback and enthusiasm, so dive in and explore what's new!

[h2]🌟 What's New in the Demo?
[/h2]
[h3]1. Beginner-Friendly Tutorial
[/h3]
New to Rogue Realms? Fear not! We've introduced an easy-to-follow tutorial to get you acquainted with the controls and basic gameplay. Whether you're a seasoned tower defense strategist or a fresh recruit in the realm, this tutorial is the perfect starting point to master your defense strategies.

[h3]2. Language Selection
[/h3]
Understanding your journey is crucial, and we're making it easier by adding language options to Rogue Realms. Now you can play in English, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, or Korean. More languages are on the way, and we'll be gradually translating the whole game. 

[h3]3. Quality of Life Improvements
[/h3]
We've also implemented several performance improvemnts, and some minor but impactful Quality of Life (QoL) improvements. These tweaks are designed to make your gameplay smoother and more enjoyable. We've listened to your feedback and are constantly refining the game to provide the best experience.

[h2]🔍 Next Steps - What's Ahead?
[/h2]
[h3]1. Visual UI Overhaul 
[/h3]
We're planning to revamp the UI to make it more visually appealing and intuitive. This means a more immersive experience that's not only functional but also pleasing to the eye.

[h3]2. Art Updates
[/h3]
We're also focusing on updating and refining the game's art. Expect more visually stunning environments, detailed characters, and an overall upgrade to the aesthetic feel of Rogue Realms.

[h2]📣 We Want to Hear From You!
[/h2]
Your input is vital in shaping Rogue Realms. If you have any suggestions, questions, or feedback on the new demo update or anything else, don't hesitate to drop a comment below. Whether it's about the new tutorial, language options, or your ideas for future updates, we're all ears!

Together, let's continue to build the enthralling world of Rogue Realms. Happy defending, heroes!

Stay vigilant, stay brave!

Rogue Realms team

notes.title: HUGE Update!
notes.content:
Hi all,

2 weeks ago we published the first demo of Rogue Realms. Well, today we bring a HUGE update, and I'm going to explain all the details of what includes. If you haven't wishlisted the game and downloaded the demo, you can do it now from the Steam page.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2690870/Rogue_Realms/

Please let me know if you have any questions or suggestions in the comments! :)

[h1]1. Update Content[/h1]

[b]Procedurally Generated Maps [/b]
Every time you play the game now you'll have a different experience. The map will be different, and the tower placements as well. Feel free to explore them and reload the game as you wish.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749928/308c9adf97adc308e30162e3e3d4fa1a3a9cf75b.gif[/img]

[b]New enemies:[/b] 
[list]
[*] Longbowman: Shoots arrows to our hero from far away. Very resistant
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749928/5b27e40816621a6406fb31e77e39da2fa863ae0a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749928/5de7008e6950f63f03be633fc0fc7e6571f54e51.png[/img][/url]
[*] Huntress: Shoots arrows at our hero from mid distance. High attack but squishy.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749928/9c99fcfd022df05939e4b6853435886cd029e5da.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749928/c443fc6afc4a8b033ecafce90915c9a23e8d0d73.png[/img][/url]
[*] Sorceress:Shoots fireballs at our hero from mid distance. High attack but squishy.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749928/5bf09d40bd084e57f1013389a3252f3d489f5037.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749928/e42742404ce1d3368860a1238d6fe86492703046.png[/img][/url]
[*] Druid: Heals the closest enemy missing HP (including herself).
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749928/2295d660d4df4d5116a96f36c9429ff03eb6fc12.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749928/06bb681c24c3cb9bd813ace633a7fc7976fc25b3.png[/img][/url][*] Assassin: If they see our hero they will chase them and attack them. Deadly attack and auto-heal themselves.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749928/4dc2eab1aa5916eb22d41c3eed73039a0c66e521.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749928/dd6998ffaa85b50298a859e373ae7ced1e54f76e.png[/img][/url]
[/list]

[b]Quality Of Live & Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where some players observed the level 2 and level 3 options when upgrading towers.
[*] Allowed bigger range of Zoom
[*] Added a survey at game end to listen to your feedback! :)
[/list]

[h1]2. What is Next[/h1]

I think this update marks a big milestone for the game. I'm going to take 2 weeks of vacation, and after that will be working on the next update, containing: 
[list]
[*] Tutorial 
[*] Correct bugs or make QoL enhancements based on your feedback Thanks!
[/list]

notes.title: DEMO IS OUT!
notes.content:
Hi all,

2 weeks ago we published the first demo of Rogue Realms. Some of you might have downloaded it and played it already. If you are one of those, thanks for that! If you are not, you can do it now from the Steam page.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2690870/Rogue_Realms/

I'll create an in-game tutorial later on, but in the meantime, today I'm going to write a short tutorial of how to play. We'll also discuss next steps and what to expect from this game.
Please let me know if you have any questions or suggestions in the comments! :)

[h1] 1. How to Play the game [/h1]
Defend the castle from 10 waves of enemies in increasing difficulty that will spawn periodically. Build powerful towers and attack with your Hero to stop the enemies. Defeat the final boss and achieve the best score possible.

[b]Instructions: [/b]
[olist]
[*] Right click to move to a Position
[*] Right click an enemy to attack it.
[*] Press W or click the Weapon button to select your weapon to use and change it during gameplay.
[*] Left click into a X tile to build a tower. Choose what tower to build and how to upgrade it. 
[*] Be close to the monsters when they are defeated to get hero exp. Level up to increase hero' stats. 
[*] When level up or when a wave finishes you get to choose a trait to upgrade.
[*] The camera moves with your mouse, and comes back to the Hero view when holding Space. You can scroll up or down to zoom in / out
[/olist]

[h1] 2. What is Next[/h1]
Soon we'll upload a HUGE update to the free Demo with:
[list]
[*] 5 new enemies
[*] Randomly generated
[/list]

Other priorities afterwards (subject to change):
[list]
[*] Tutorial (in-game)
[*] Full Run, where you will find different stages, and get increasing levels and difficulties
[*] Replace some placeholders with final art
[*] Massive polish: UI, gameplay, SFX and more.
[*] Many others...
[/list]
